## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

## 3.34.2. Emergency lighting

- Escape lighting should come on within 5 seconds of the failure of normal lighting and provide at least 1 lux luminance at floor level
- > The area immediately outside the final exit must be illuminated.

## 3.34.3. Inspection & maintenance

- >Arrangements for installation and maintenance of lighting must be put in place to ensure that lighting is checked and maintained asadequate and ingood order
- As theconstructionproceeds theelectrical installationswill bemoved and altered and thereforeit is usual for such installations to be subjected to thorough inspection and testing at intervals which will never exceed three months

## 3.34.4. Lighting Levels

- A Illumination levels are to be checked using a lux meter during the shift and records kept.
- Metal halide and conventional tungsten or tungsten halogen lighting should be used. The use of high pressure sodium lighting should be avoided due to the potential fire risk.
- Onlycompetent electricians are to install lighting.Personnel who arerequired to transport,position, raise and lowermobilelightingtowersaretobe trained and supervised.
- Therecommendedminimum levelsofillumination tobeprovided areshowninTablebelow.

| Purpose               | Governing Factors                                                                        | Design Value (lux)   |
|-----------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------|
| Security              | Depending on the degree of risk                                                          | 5-30                 |
| Emergeney lighting    | For escape and standby purposes                                                          | 5-70                 |
| Movement and handling | Movement of people,machines and vehicles,handlingof materials,walkways and access routes | 20                   |
| Stores and yards      | For stored goods and materials                                                           | 30                   |
| Site entranees        | General access,vehicle and pedestrian                                                    | 30                   |
| General work areas    | General rough work,site clearance                                                        | 50                   |
| Craft Work            | Reinforcing concrete,shuttering erection, bricklaying,scaffolding                        | 100                  |
| Site huts             | Rest rooms,locker rooms,toilets                                                          | 150                  |
